ko.explanation: ㄱ을 두 번 쓴 된소리(경음) 글자입니다. 목을 긴장시키고 세게 발음합니다. '까', '꼬', '꾸' 등에 쓰입니다.

examples.master: 된소리(경음)는 한국어 고유의 삼지 대립(평음-경음-격음) 체계의 핵심입니다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: ㄲ과 ㄱ의 차이가 뭐예요?
dialogue.translation: What's the difference between ㄲ and ㄱ?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: ㄲ은 목에 힘을 주고 세게 발음해요.
dialogue.romanization: ssang-giyeogeun moge himeul jugo sege bareumaheyo.
dialogue.translation: ㄲ is pronounced with throat tension and more force.

en.explanation: A tense (fortis) consonant, written as double ㄱ. Pronounced with a tight throat and no aspiration. Similar to an unaspirated 'k' in English 'skill'.

examples.advanced: "ㄲ" is a tense consonant [k͈], produced with glottal tension.
examples.master: Tense consonants are part of Korean's three-way distinction: lax (ㄱ), tense (ㄲ), aspirated (ㅋ).

formal: ㄲ is the tense form of ㄱ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What's the difference between ㄲ and ㄱ?
dialogue.translation: ㄲ과 ㄱ의 차이가 뭐예요?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: ㄲ is pronounced with throat tension and more force.
dialogue.translation: ㄲ은 목에 힘을 주고 세게 발음해요.

ko.explanation: ㄷ을 두 번 쓴 된소리(경음) 글자입니다. '따', '또', '뚜' 등에 쓰입니다.

examples.master: "ㄸ"은 ㄷ(평음)과 ㅌ(격음)의 중간이 아니라, 별도의 조음 방식입니다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: ㄸ은 어떻게 발음해요?
dialogue.translation: How do you pronounce ㄸ?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 목에 힘을 주고 '따' 하고 세게 말해요.
dialogue.romanization: moge himeul jugo 'tta' hago sege malhaeyo.
dialogue.translation: Tense your throat and say 'tta' firmly.

en.explanation: A tense consonant, double ㄷ. Pronounced with throat tension, like an unaspirated 't' in English 'stop'.

examples.advanced: "ㄸ" is a tense consonant [t͈], produced with glottal tension.
examples.master: "ㄸ" is distinct from both ㄷ (lax) and ㅌ (aspirated) in Korean's three-way system.

formal: ㄸ is the tense form of ㄷ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How do you pronounce ㄸ?
dialogue.translation: ㄸ은 어떻게 발음해요?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Tense your throat and say 'tta' firmly.
dialogue.translation: 목에 힘을 주고 '따' 하고 세게 말해요.

ko.explanation: ㅂ을 두 번 쓴 된소리(경음) 글자입니다. '빠', '뽀', '뿌' 등에 쓰입니다.

examples.advanced: "ㅃ"은 경음 [p͈]로, 기식 없이 긴장된 양순 파열음입니다.
examples.master: "ㅃ"은 영어의 'spy'에서 'p'와 비슷하지만, 성문 긴장이 더 강합니다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: '빠르다'의 'ㅃ'은 'ㅂ'과 뭐가 달라요?
dialogue.translation: How is 'ㅃ' in '빠르다' different from 'ㅂ'?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 입술에 더 힘을 주고, 숨을 안 내보내요.
dialogue.romanization: ipsure deo himeul jugo, sumeul an naebonaeyo.
dialogue.translation: Use more lip tension and don't release air.

en.explanation: A tense consonant, double ㅂ. Pronounced with tight lips and no aspiration, like 'p' in 'spy'.

examples.advanced: "ㅃ" is a tense bilabial stop [p͈], unaspirated with glottal tension.
examples.master: "ㅃ" is similar to 'p' in English 'spy' but with stronger glottal tension.

formal: ㅃ is the tense form of ㅂ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How is ㅃ in '빠르다' different from ㅂ?
dialogue.translation: '빠르다'의 'ㅃ'은 'ㅂ'과 뭐가 달라요?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Use more lip tension and don't release air.
dialogue.translation: 입술에 더 힘을 주고, 숨을 안 내보내요.

ko.explanation: ㅅ을 두 번 쓴 된소리(경음) 글자입니다. '싸', '쏘', '쓰' 등에 쓰이며, 과거형 '-었/았-'에서도 매우 자주 나타납니다.

examples.advanced: "ㅆ"은 경음 [s͈]로, 'ㅣ' 앞에서 [ɕ͈]로 변합니다. 받침으로도 자주 씁니다.
examples.master: "ㅆ"은 과거시제 선어말어미 '-았/었-'의 받침으로 가장 빈번하게 사용됩니다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: '했다'에서 ㅆ 받침이 왜 있어요?
dialogue.translation: Why does '했다' have ㅆ as a final consonant?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 과거형을 만드는 '-었-'에 ㅆ이 쓰여요.
dialogue.translation: ㅆ is used in the past tense marker '-었-'.

en.explanation: A tense consonant, double ㅅ. Pronounced like a sharp 'ss'. Very common as a final consonant in past tense verb forms.

examples.advanced: "ㅆ" is a tense fricative [s͈], becoming [ɕ͈] before 'i'. Also very common as batchim.
examples.master: "ㅆ" appears frequently as the final consonant in past tense markers '-았/었-' (했다, 갔다, etc.).

formal: ㅆ is the tense form of ㅅ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Why does '했다' have ㅆ as a final consonant?
dialogue.translation: '했다'에서 ㅆ 받침이 왜 있어요?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: ㅆ is used in the past tense marker '-었-'.
dialogue.translation: 과거형을 만드는 '-었-'에 ㅆ이 쓰여요.

ko.explanation: ㅈ을 두 번 쓴 된소리(경음) 글자입니다. '짜', '쪼', '쭈' 등에 쓰입니다.

examples.master: "ㅉ"은 한국어 삼지 대립에서 경음 파찰음으로, 성문 긴장이 핵심 특징입니다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: ㅉ, ㅈ, ㅊ 세 개가 다 달라요?
dialogue.romanization: ssang-jieut, jieut, chieut se gaega da dallayo?
dialogue.translation: Are ㅉ, ㅈ, ㅊ all different?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 네. ㅈ은 보통, ㅉ은 세게, ㅊ은 숨을 내뱉으면서요.
dialogue.romanization: ne. jieuseun botong, ssang-jieuseun sege, chieuseun sumeul nabaetteumyeonseyo.
dialogue.translation: Yes. ㅈ is normal, ㅉ is tense, ㅊ is with a puff of air.

en.explanation: A tense consonant, double ㅈ. Pronounced like a tight 'jj' with no aspiration. Completes the three-way distinction: ㅈ (lax), ㅉ (tense), ㅊ (aspirated).

examples.advanced: "ㅉ" is a tense affricate [t͈ɕ], distinct from ㅈ (lax) and ㅊ (aspirated).
examples.master: "ㅉ" represents the tense member of Korean's three-way affricate distinction.

formal: ㅉ is the tense form of ㅈ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Are ㅉ, ㅈ, ㅊ all different?
dialogue.translation: ㅉ, ㅈ, ㅊ 세 개가 다 달라요?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes. ㅈ is normal, ㅉ is tense, ㅊ is with a puff of air.
dialogue.translation: 네. ㅈ은 보통, ㅉ은 세게, ㅊ은 숨을 내뱉으면서요.
